name: guide-driven-development
title_zh: 客户手册当主干，代码测试跟着它长
tagline_zh: 每次改需求，先改手册再动代码，测试同步更新。仓库里永远有一份能直接读给客户听的真话。
tagline_en: Change the guide first, then code and tests follow. Your repo always holds one honest doc you can read aloud to.
desc_en: Use Guide-Driven Development (GDD) as an ongoing approach to product planning, implementation, and review. Keep customer guides, internal design knowledge, implementation, and tests aligned as the repository evolves.
why_zh: 把指南设为唯一事实源，实现、测试、文档三者由同一份需求驱动，杜绝漂移。适合产品迭代快、怕文档骗人的团队。
why_en: Makes the guide the single source of truth, so implementation, tests, and docs are driven by one spec—no drift. For teams that.
limit_zh: 只覆盖有明确客户可读指南的功能域；纯内部算法或探索性原型没有指南可写，这套流程会卡住。需要团队已习惯先写文档再写码。
limit_en: Only works where a customer-readable guide exists; pure internal algorithms or prototypes stall it. Requires a team already comfortable writing docs.
title_en: Customer guide as trunk, code & tests grow along it
